summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new flagship Toolbox Talks V2 and COSHH V2 tools. Backend pytest: 18/19 pass (94.7%). One backend defect found — PATCH /api/coshh/assessments/{id} returns 422 because AssessmentUpdate model reassigns __annotations__ inside the class body, which Pydantic doesn't process; every field ends up required=True and any partial update payload fails validation. Toolbox Talks: GET /topics returns 16 correctly shaped topics; templates POST/DELETE (soft delete) work; empty-name → 400; stats endpoint returns the expected shape. COSHH: hazards library returns 9 pictograms + H/P statement lists; assessments CRUD works (create, list, delete soft-delete, 404 on missing); stats returns full breakdown; templates CRUD works; unauthenticated calls return 401/403; review-due within 20 days shows up in /api/attention with kind='coshh_review_due' and severity='warning'. Frontend: /app/toolbox-talk renders with all 8 stepper tiles, Step 1 pre-fills presenter='Darren Morris', all 16 topic cards + custom button present, all Step-3 bullet-editor lists render, Step 4 attendee row with sign button opens, Step 6 linked-doc groups all present, Step 8 generate button present. /app/coshh renders with 5 stat cards, new/search/status-filter controls, 12-step wizard with all step tiles, projectName/assessor/date/reviewDate fields (assessor auto-filled), pictogram grid GHS01/02/05/09, PPE grid gloves/goggles/respirator, and Step 12 save-btn. Saving via UI successfully persisted a row (4 coshh-row-* tiles after save). All regression routes /app/rams, /app/method-statement, /app/finance, /app/business, /app/compliance, /app/settings, /app/tools-library render without errors. Tools Library H&S category shows RAMS, Method Statement, Risk Register, COSHH Assessment, Toolbox Talk, Site Diary etc.

critical.issue: Returns 422 on any partial update. Root cause: `AssessmentUpdate` in /app/backend/coshh.py:106-108 does `__annotations__ = AssessmentIn.__annotations__` inside the class body, but Pydantic v2 does not inherit the default values from AssessmentIn via that assignment. Result: every field except productName is required=True. Verified via python REPL: all 30 fields show required=True. Fix: make AssessmentUpdate inherit from AssessmentIn and override every field as Optional with default None, OR use `class AssessmentUpdate(AssessmentIn):` combined with a model_validator that ignores missing fields, OR simply define a separate model with all fields Optional[...] = None.

rca of the issue: Backend PATCH 422: In pydantic v2, defining `class AssessmentUpdate(BaseModel): __annotations__ = AssessmentIn.__annotations__` does NOT copy the class attributes (defaults) from AssessmentIn — only the type hints — so every previously-defaulted Optional field becomes a required field. Reproduction: `python -c 'from backend.coshh import AssessmentUpdate; [print(n, f.is_required()) for n,f in AssessmentUpdate.model_fields.items()]'` shows every field except the explicitly-overridden productName has required=True. Mitigation: change to `class AssessmentUpdate(AssessmentIn):` and override every field as Optional with default None, or better: `AssessmentUpdate = create_model('AssessmentUpdate', **{n: (Optional[t], None) for n, t in AssessmentIn.__annotations__.items()})`.
